Field
Description
ImageFileName
The full path to an executable (PE) file. The context of this field provides more information as to its meaning. For ProcessRollup2
events, this is the full path to the main executable for the created process.
ImageFileIdentifier
24-byte unique file identifer for a binary executable image.
BundleID
CommandLineParameters
UserSid
The User Security Identifier (UserSID) of the user who executed the command. A UserSID uniquely identifies a user in a system.
Values:
SELF_RID (0x01010000000000050A000000)
UserName
Operating system username.
UserSecurityDomain
Domain for the file/process/registry owner (mapped from SID).
StartUpLogonNumber
StartupInfo logon number.
FfcFileIdentifier
24-byte concatenation of a filesystem volume's UUID and a file's inode value.
TargetProcessId
The unique ID of a target process (in decimal, non-hex format). This field exists in almost all events, and it represents the ID of the
process that is responsible for the activity of the event in focus. For example, the TargetProcessId of a process that performed
thread injection in an InjectedThread event
ProcessCpuUsageMicroSec CPU cycles used by process in micro-seconds.
ProcessDiskUsageBytes
Disk storage used by process in bytes.
ParentBaseFileName
The base ImageFileName of the parent process.
ParentProcessId
The decimal representation of the parent process.
ParentProcessStartTime
Start time of parent process.
ProcessStartedInTraceSec
Number of seconds process has been monitored.
